description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of four different model configurations across four distinct metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Metrics", and displays four discrete metric groups from left to right: "EGP ↑", "TR-N ↓", a metric with a visually obscured grey rectangular label followed by "↓", and "CCP ↑". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Performance", using a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The chart features grouped vertical bars, with each metric category containing a cluster of four bars. According to the legend, the bars within each group represent different methods and models, color-coded as follows: blue for "Greedy (CodeLlama-7B)", yellow-orange for "RPG (CodeLlama-7B)", green for "Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)", and dark orange for "RPG (CodeLlama-34B)". The approximate values vary across the metrics and models. For "EGP ↑", the blue bar is the shortest in the entire chart at approximately 0.01, while the dark orange bar is the tallest at approximately 0.99; the yellow-orange and green bars are roughly 0.89 and 0.59, respectively. In the "TR-N ↓" category, values are approximately 0.71 (blue), 0.46 (yellow-orange), 0.62 (green), and 0.40 (dark orange). For the obscured metric category, the bars measure about 0.69 (blue), 0.43 (yellow-orange), 0.45 (green), and 0.31 (dark orange). Finally, for "CCP ↑", the values are approximately 0.40 (blue), 0.72 (yellow-orange), 0.70 (green), and 0.94 (dark orange). The bars are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order across the chart. Visual emphasis includes the upward and downward arrows annotated next to each metric label on the horizontal axis, as well as the grey shading obscuring the text of the third metric label.
